title: Namaz for Settling the Debts and Saving from Despotic Rulers
categoryChain: Namaz for Settling the Debts and Saving from Despotic Rulers
introduction:
RITE OF THE HOLY QURAN ON THE HEAD

A sacred practice of the Blessed Laylat al-Qadr and urgent supplications seeking intercession through the Word of Allah and the Pure Infallibles.

verses.translation: You should then carry the book of the Holy Qur’an, put it on your head, and say the following supplication:
O Allah, in the name of this (Holy) Qur'an,
in the name of him with whom You have sent it,

verses.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ كُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ مَدَحْتَهُ فِيْهِ
verses.translation: in the name of every believer whom You have praised therein,
and in the name of their duty towards You,
for no one is aware of Your right more than You are.
You should then repeat each of the following words ten times:
O Ja'far the son of Muhammad!
O Müsä the son of Ja'far!

You may then ask for what you need.

The reporter added: After some time, the man returned to Imam al-Sadiq(a.s.) after he had settled his debt, built good relations with the ruling authorities, and become financially well-appointed.

It seems this supplication must be said after the prayer.
